description: This Java source file defines an abstract class ModelTreeAction and multiple subclasses representing different actions within a widget tree, such as entity queries, scripts, and services, for the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles reading, parsing, and executing tree actions in the context of widget models.

classes.name: ModelTreeAction
classes.description: Abstract class representing a tree action in the widget model, providing static methods to read actions from XML elements and subclasses for specific action types (entity-and, entity-condition, script, service).

classes.name: ModelTreeAction.EntityAnd
classes.description: Represents an 'entity-and' query action, performing entity fetch based on multiple conditions, supporting cache control and list iteration.

classes.name: ModelTreeAction.EntityCondition
classes.description: Represents an 'entity-condition' query action, performing entity fetch based on a single condition, supporting cache control and list iteration.

classes.name: ModelTreeAction.Script
classes.description: Represents a 'script' action, executing a script located at a specified location or method.

classes.name: ModelTreeAction.Service
classes.description: Represents a 'service' action, calling an OFBiz service with parameters, handling result mapping, and updating the context or sub-node list.

methods.name: readNodeActions
methods.description: Static method to parse XML 'actions' element and instantiate corresponding ModelAction objects.

methods.name: readSubNodeActions
methods.description: Static method to parse XML 'actions' element for sub-node actions and instantiate corresponding ModelAction objects.
